visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens with a wide shot of a FamilyMart convenience store exterior under bright daylight. A green and blue banner sits above the automatic glass doors, while a red promotional flag stands to the left. (2) Inside the store, a person's hand reaches out to hold a white and blue yogurt container with pear illustrations. The camera zooms in as the lid is peeled back, revealing a creamy white texture with large, translucent fruit chunks. (3) A pink tub of ice cream is shown resting on a shelf inside a freezer case, surrounded by various other frozen dessert packages. (4) The camera focuses on a display of blue and white seafood-flavored cup noodles stacked on retail shelves. A hand is seen pouring hot water from a kettle into an open noodle cup. (5) A blue rectangular box of almond chocolates is held up against a shelf of similar snacks. A close-up shot shows a single chocolate piece bitten in half, revealing a crunchy biscuit center and a whole nut. (6) Multiple cans of watermelon-themed alcoholic beverages are arranged on a refrigerated shelf. The hand holds one can to the camera, showing a graphic of a sliced watermelon. (7) A blue bag of seafood-flavored snack sticks is presented in a close-up shot, with store shelves visible in the background. (8) A white chocolate bar wrapper featuring a cow character is shown, followed by a bag of mini cookies. (9) A box of baked chocolate squares is held, with yellow and brown packaging details clearly visible. (10) The final phase transitions to a static graphic screen with a pink background, featuring social media icons for Facebook, Instagram, and YouTube, alongside a website URL.

(3) [Subtitle]: 最大特色就是裡面有半顆完整果肉. 超大塊山形縣產的梨子 吃起來超過癮的啊. (4) [Subtitle]: 2. MOW 水蜜桃白色沙瓦冰. 這個新口味感覺好清爽. 水蜜桃愛好者可以買! (5) [Subtitle]: 3. 日清 高湯版泡麵. 升級版日清泡麵! (6) [Subtitle]: 就差在這包粉包! 裡面融合了三種高湯風味 湯頭喝起來有一股香味. (7) [Logo]: 全家. [Subtitle]: 4. 明治 沖縄鹽杏仁可可粒. 類似米果的小餅乾. 這個期間限定口味超好吃! 咬起來很香脆, 鹹鹹甜甜的. (8) [Subtitle]: 5. 麒麟冰結 尾花澤西瓜口味. 很有夏日感的期間限定口味. 而且酒精濃度比較沒那麼高呦~ (9) [Subtitle]: 6. Calbee 鳴門鹽帆立貝柱口味. 海鮮的香味更濃郁. 口感也更扎實酥脆! (10) [Logo]: 7-11. [Subtitle]: 7. MILKMANIA巧克力棒. 為牛奶愛好者打造的巧克力棒. 奶香味十足! (11) [Subtitle]: 8. 不二家 富岡絲綢牛奶餅乾. 加入了富岡製絲廠的蠶絲粉. 味道就像很滑順的牛奶冰淇淋. (12) [Subtitle]: 9. 森永 岩鹽餅乾巧克力. 咬起來脆脆的. 使用烘焙巧克力 不會輕易融化! (13) [Slogan]: 看更多資訊請點IG首頁連結. [Logo]: 日本失心瘋 japanuts.com, facebook, instagram, youtube. [Variety]: 按讚 留言 分享.
